component.name: Big Audio Converter
component.summary: Convert audio and export selected segments

description.p: Convert local audio to MP3, FLAC, Vorbis, WAV, AAC or Opus, or extract a selected audio track from video. Preview effects and edit segments using a waveform or numeric keyboard controls.

Fast Copy avoids audio re-encoding, with cut precision limited by the codec and container. Optional speech noise reduction requires the GTCRN plugin. Tags and cover art are preserved where the destination supports them.
